title: Vivid slider thumb lacks a readable boundary on the drawer surface
scope: Confirmed during the selected UX-003 review; add a local boundary without muting the selected accent or changing sensitivity behavior.
evidence: Light Yellow actual Windows thumb/drawer contrast is 1.236:1 in out/ux003/before-focused.txt; native Android actual boundary is 1.238:1 in out/ux003/android-before-final/results.json. Original thumb has no border except during keyboard focus.
implementation: Keep the accent fill/track. Enabled thumb uses a 0.2 mm normal Material primaryTextColor boundary; keyboard focus retains 0.4 mm. Disabled non-focused thumb retains no outline.

regression.test: tests/customcolors/tst_customcolors.qml::test_slider_thumb verifies the actual painted boundary in all 19 families and themes, and retains the exact vivid fill.
regression.before: Actual original Windows and Android boundary pixels fail 3:1.
regression.after: Final offscreen custom-color matrix: 268 passed. Native Windows D3D11 WARP: 282 passed. Both are normal CTest entries, with zero failures/skips; original-source negative controls fail as recorded. Full suite reports total 1,622 records across 17 entries.
regression.android: tests/android/test_customcolors.py samples real thumb center/fill and boundary against the actual drawer surface.
regression.android_after: All 48 native custom-color checks pass across six profiles. Actual Light thumb boundary is about 11.16:1; Dark about 21:1, while the exact vivid center fill is retained. Evidence: out/ux003/android-colors-final/results.json.
regression.final_before: out/ux003/thumb-before-final-fixture.txt: original Slider source under native D3D11 WARP has zero readable contour core pixels and fails the final test. Restored fix passes all 282 native custom-color records in customcolor-native-contour.log.
regression.driver_notes: Initial single-coordinate sampling landed beside the subpixel contour under D3D11 and produced 17 fixture failures. The final test samples the actual top arc for three readable core pixels, excludes the track/background, and fails on the original unfocused Yellow thumb. Offscreen all 268 and native all 282 pass without changing the production outline.

verification.windows: Combined color/Undo tree: All 17 normal Windows CTest entries pass: 1622 records, zero failures/skips. General entries, the main UI rerun including the new drawer test, and corrected offscreen/native custom-color rechecks were run in filtered groups. See out/ux003/windows-results.json and logs.
verification.static_analysis: Both Samuel-profile clang-tidy and Clazy pass all 7 tracked C++ translation units (14 analyzer runs), out/ux003/analysis.
verification.qml_lint: QShopper_qmllint exits 0 with five existing warnings: RoundButton alias, Qt.inputMethod commit/show QObject, and generated keyboard item.active/implicitHeight QObject. No new warnings in changed color bindings.
verification.formatting: All 67 tracked QML/templates and all 11 tracked C++ files match accepted formatter configurations. git diff --check passes.
verification.android: Combined color/Undo tree: All 283 native Android checks pass on the final APK: 48 custom colors, 6 post-reset cleanup, 24 recovery/IME/expiry/resume, 26 full About, 42 popup contrast and 137 System drawer/safe-area checks. Source scripts use isolated data; commands completed with clean final teardown. Reports are retained in out/ux003 and out/ux005.
verification.environment_notes: Initial native popup assertions all 42 passed but teardown timed out after emulator host-GPU external-memory/context errors. A fresh emulator rerun passes 42 with exit 0. System/safe-area harness rejected an old shared /sdcard XML file (Bad address); the final driver uses a unique shell-temporary dump and its 137 checks pass. These host/driver failures are retained as validation history, not additional application defects.

Gradle rejected OneDrive resource reparse metadata, so final APKs were assembled from byte-identical generated inputs in task-specific temporary staging outside OneDrive, then signed/contract-checked. Logs and helper are retained in out/ux003; repository build scripts are unchanged.

resolution.acceptance: 2026-11-07: user tested the supplied APK and requested: Tested, Close and Commit.
resolution.summary: Keep the vivid slider fill and add a readable neutral thumb outline.
resolution.verification: Combined color/Undo tree: all 17 Windows suites pass (1,622 records), all 283 native Android checks pass, both APK package/signature checks pass, and formatter/static-analysis results are recorded above.
resolution.regression: Permanent test locations, original-source failures, passing-after results and fixture/environment dispositions are recorded in this ticket and its linked review.
resolution.remaining: None within the accepted scope. Broader physical-shopping, dictation and accessibility studies remain their separate QA scope.
